name: GPS Reroute
summary: Your release is a route on a tilted map; Pulse spots the hazard ahead, shows 'Recalculating…', and you confirm the safe road and still arrive on time.
look: A clean light vector city in true perspective (white streets, pale blocks, mint parks) with a thick teal route ribbon and a white-and-teal nav puck. Dark nav banners, a coral hazard pin and white bottom sheets borrow the grammar of every map app.

components.name: Tilted vector map
components.role: light streets, parks and blocks at ~48° perspective

components.name: Route line
components.role: thick teal ribbon with a progress head; the release

components.name: Nav banner
components.role: 'Recalculating…' plus the anomaly as the hazard reason

components.name: Hazard pin
components.role: coral pin with a '−18%' tag just ahead of the puck

components.name: Bottom sheet
components.role: the human confirm; becomes the arrival CTA sheet

motion.name: Route draw
motion.how: stroke-dashoffset progress over two bars (4 s at 120 BPM), linear, with a lerp-smoothed camera (0.12) following the head

motion.name: Bearing drift
motion.how: slow map rotation of about 6° across the scene, sine.inOut

motion.name: Reroute snap
motion.how: old path fades to dashed grey in 0.2 s; new path draws in 0.35 s expo.out on the downbeat after the tap; banner flips with a 0.25 s rotateX

story: Hook: 38 grey pins rain onto a flat map, 'Arrived: Friday 17:40 · too late'. Reveal: the map tilts back, the dark banner drops with the Acme mark and 'Acme Pulse', and the teal route draws on the drop. Proof: a coral hazard pin drops ahead; the banner reads 'Recalculating… Checkout conversion −18% · since 09:42 · after deploy #2231'; the human taps Roll back and the safe route snaps in with customers still on time. CTA: arrival flag, a white arrival sheet with the lockup, 'You ship. Pulse watches.', Start free.
adapt: Make the route whatever your users move through (a checkout, a migration, onboarding, a month-end close) and let the hazard be the issue your product detects.

references.note: line-gradient route progress with a lerped camera

fit.risk: Can suggest the AI changes things by itself; always show the human's confirm tap before the route changes.
